newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso closes firmer on stock gains.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso closes firmer on stock gains.

text.p: Foreign investors stepping into the stock market along with dollar supply from local dealers made the same-day peso close 1.5 centavos firmer at 7.4800/7.4850 per dollar on Wednesday, its strongest level in September, traders said.
"We've seen dollars sold by foreigners and the odd local who is probably going short, but amounts have generally been moderate," a currency trader said.

This was the first time the same-day peso closed stronger than the psychological mark of 7.50 on the offer side since August 28. It was bouyed by foreigners selling dollars to buy peso securities in the stock market.
Meanwhile, as the same-day market closed, the benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart were respectively 1.4 and 1.3 centavos firmer at 7.4890/7.4910 and 7.4840/7.4880 per dollar.
Nonetheless, traders estimated that the peso could lose some of its early strength in these markets to close nearer 7.50 per dollar.
